## 2026-01-13 - [ASCII Visualizations in Text Reports]
**Learning:** Even in text-only environments like Markdown reports generated by CLI tools, visual data representation significantly improves readability. ASCII bar charts provide immediate visual weight to numerical data without needing external image generation or complex dependencies.
**Action:** When generating text-based reports, always look for opportunities to visualize distribution or comparison data using simple block characters (`█`, `░`) to make the report "scannable".
